evidence: Reads the item_archetype property (NSO address 0x7001ce727b) through f_7000a64520, then scans a collection with f_7000d21d4c/f_7000d21c80/f_7000d21ce8, counting entries whose selected value equals the requested one; called repeatedly by an enclosing indexed routine. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0065.c:53207-53303; decompiled/main/main_0066.c:1250-1262,1604-1616.

Reads the energy property (NSO address 0x7001d45e1e), derives a uint32 value from the second argument with fallback cases, then writes that value with f_7000a65090 unless the lookup/update helper reports failure. A direct caller supplies a selected object and zero value after validating a nested result. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0065.c:41762-41799; decompiled/main/main_0080.c:41360-41394.

Looks up DATA_C_CURRENT (NSO address 0x7001c9b384) on a context, obtains an id from the current-player object, and stores the 32-bit result at object offset 0x1b0; returns status 2 on unsuccessful prerequisites and 0 on the update path. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0083.c:53990-54031.

Looks up DATA_PG_CURRENT (NSO address 0x7001d357cf), obtains an id from the current-player object, and stores the 32-bit result at object offset 0x1b8; returns a boolean-like success status. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0084.c:43525-43566.

Looks up CURRENT_PLAYER (NSO address 0x7001d50068) on the input object; if present, checks the returned object's id property and, when it is nonzero, invokes f_70007df6bc with the original object and value 0. The direct neighboring function f_7000afe570 uses the same CURRENT_PLAYER key and updates related state; no direct callers found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0077.c:54478-54515,54517-54530.

Looks up CURRENT_PLAYER (NSO address 0x7001d50068), reads id from the result, and when the property is present invokes f_70007df6bc on the original object with that id; this is the same operation as f_7000afe4f8 with the extracted id passed as an argument. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0077.c:55845-55880.
